requirements.businessContext: The Feedback module lets logged-in teams submit free-text feedback either about the JPL-Leagues platform in general (scope="site", visible to superadmins only) or about a specific league they are in (scope="league", visible to that league's admins plus superadmins). Admins and superadmins read feedback in a new Feedback tab on the league admin dashboard and on the superadmin dashboard; per row they can flag a row important, mark it resolved (with an optional one-line note), or delete it. The data lives in a single `feedback` table with a nullable `leagueId` and a typed `scope` enum.

userStories.iWant: to submit free-text feedback either about the platform as a whole or about my current league
userStories.soThat: I can flag bugs, request features, or share concerns with the people who can act on them

userStories.iWant: to read every feedback row submitted against my league and triage each one (flag important, mark resolved, delete)
userStories.soThat: I can keep on top of what my teams are saying about this league

userStories.iWant: to read every site-wide feedback row (and triage them with the same actions as league admins)
userStories.soThat: I see the global health of the platform and can prioritise platform-level work

businessRules.rule: The `feedback` table holds free-text user submissions with a typed scope ("site" | "league"), a nullable `leagueId` (null only when scope="site"), the submitter's team id + name (denormalised), an optional subject, the message body, an isImportant boolean, a resolvedAt timestamp (nullable), an optional resolutionNote, and createdAt/updatedAt timestamps.

POST /api/feedback requires a team session (x-session-type=team, x-session-id set). When scope="league" the leagueId is derived from the submitter's team row — the client may not supply it. When scope="site" the leagueId is forced to null.

POST /api/feedback validates: scope ∈ {"site","league"} (else 400); message is a string trimmed to length ≥5 and ≤5000 (else 400); subject is optional, trimmed to ≤200 chars (else 400). The trimmed values are persisted; an empty subject becomes null.

GET /api/admin/[leagueId]/feedback returns ONLY rows where scope="league" AND leagueId=<param>, ordered by createdAt descending. Access is gated by getAuthorizedLeagueId — league admins (active league) and superadmins pass; everyone else gets 403.
GET /api/superadmin/feedback returns ONLY rows where scope="site", ordered by createdAt descending. Superadmin session required; everyone else gets 403.

PATCH /api/feedback/[id] supports two actions: "toggle-important" flips isImportant; "toggle-resolved" sets resolvedAt=now() and resolutionNote (optional, trimmed, ≤500 chars) when currently null, OR clears both when currently set. Every successful mutation bumps updatedAt.

PATCH and DELETE /api/feedback/[id] load the row first, then enforce access by scope: site-scope rows require superadmin; league-scope rows require admin of that league (in leagueAdmins for the row's leagueId, with league active) OR superadmin. Anyone else gets 403; missing rows return 404.
DELETE /api/feedback/[id] hard-deletes the row after passing access control. There is no soft-delete or undo.

Foreign-key cascades: deleting a league removes all feedback rows scoped to it; deleting a team removes that team's submitted feedback rows. Site-scope rows (leagueId=null) survive league deletions and are only removed by their submitter team's deletion or an explicit DELETE on the feedback row.

The user-facing feedback page at /[leagueSlug]/feedback is gated by an authenticated team session; unauthenticated users are redirected to /signin. The page exposes a scope dropdown with two options — the current league (default) and "Site (general)" — plus an optional subject and required message textarea. A Feedback nav link appears in LeagueNav for logged-in users in all three formats (TVT, Triple Crown, Auction).

The Feedback admin tab (league admin dashboard + superadmin dashboard) shows rows sorted by createdAt descending with badges: yellow border + "Important" pill when isImportant=true; green tint + "Resolved" pill when resolvedAt is set. Each row exposes Flag important / Unflag, Mark resolved / Reopen, and Delete (with confirmation) buttons. Resolved rows show the resolutionNote inline when present.

acceptanceCriteria.when: team A POSTs /api/feedback with { scope: "site", message: "Login flow is confusing on mobile." }
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 201; a row lands in `feedback` with scope="site", leagueId=null, submitterTeamId=A.id, submitterName=A.name, subject=null, message="Login flow is confusing on mobile.", isImportant=false, resolvedAt=null

acceptanceCriteria.given: team A is signed in and belongs to league L
acceptanceCriteria.when: team A POSTs /api/feedback with { scope: "league", subject: "GW8 scoring", message: "My captain double didn't apply for GW8 — please check." }
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 201; a row lands with scope="league", leagueId=L.id (server-derived), subject="GW8 scoring", message preserved

acceptanceCriteria.when: team A POSTs /api/feedback with { scope: "site", message: "hi" } (3 characters, under the 5-char minimum)
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 400 with error "message must be between 5 and 5000 characters"; no row is inserted
HTTP 400 with error "scope must be 'site' or 'league'"; no row is inserted
HTTP 401 with error "Not authenticated"; no row inserted

acceptanceCriteria.given: league L has 3 feedback rows scoped to it and 2 site-scoped rows
acceptanceCriteria.when: an admin of league L (active league) calls GET /api/admin/L.id/feedback
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 200 with { feedback: [...] } containing exactly 3 rows — only those with scope="league" AND leagueId=L.id — ordered by createdAt descending

acceptanceCriteria.given: league L1 and L2 exist; an admin of L1 attempts to read feedback for L2
acceptanceCriteria.when: GET /api/admin/L2.id/feedback with the L1 admin's session
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 403 (the admin is not in leagueAdmins for L2)

acceptanceCriteria.given: 5 site-scoped feedback rows + 7 league-scoped rows exist in the DB
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 200 with exactly 5 rows — only those with scope="site" — ordered by createdAt descending

acceptanceCriteria.given: a league admin tries to read /api/superadmin/feedback
feedback row F (scope="league", isImportant=false) exists in a league the admin owns
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 200; the row's isImportant flips to true; updatedAt bumps; a second call flips it back to false

acceptanceCriteria.when: the league admin PATCHes /api/feedback/F.id with { action: "toggle-resolved", resolutionNote: "Fixed in GW9 export." }
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 200; resolvedAt is set to now(); resolutionNote is stored; a follow-up PATCH with the same action clears both fields (un-resolve)

acceptanceCriteria.given: an admin of league L1 attempts to PATCH a feedback row F scoped to league L2
acceptanceCriteria.when: PATCH /api/feedback/F.id with the L1 admin's session

acceptanceCriteria.given: a league admin attempts to PATCH a site-scoped feedback row
acceptanceCriteria.when: PATCH /api/feedback/F.id with the admin's session (no superadmin)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin PATCHes either a site-scoped or any league-scoped feedback row
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 200; the action succeeds regardless of which league the row belongs to

acceptanceCriteria.given: feedback row F exists in league L
acceptanceCriteria.then: HTTP 200; the row no longer exists in `feedback` (verified by a follow-up SELECT)

acceptanceCriteria.given: league L is hard-deleted from the DB
acceptanceCriteria.when: all feedback rows with leagueId=L.id are inspected after the delete
acceptanceCriteria.then: they are gone (cascade fired). Site-scope rows are unaffected.
the visitor is redirected to /signin (no form rendered)

testCases.scenario: Logged-in team submits site-wide feedback
testCases.preconditions: Team A is signed in and has a valid session
testCases.testData: scope="site", message="Login flow is confusing on mobile."
testSteps: 1. POST /api/feedback with the body { scope: "site", message: "Login flow is confusing on mobile." }.
2. Read the response status and body.
3. SELECT * FROM feedback WHERE id = response.id.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201; response body { success: true, id: <uuid> }; DB row has scope="site", leagueId=null, submitterTeamId=A.id, submitterName=A.name, message preserved, isImportant=false, resolvedAt=null
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: League-scoped submission derives leagueId from session, not from client
testCases.preconditions: Team A is signed in; A.leagueId = L1
testCases.testData: scope="league", subject="GW8 scoring", message="My captain double didn't apply for GW8 — please check."
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201; DB row has scope="league", leagueId=L1 (NOT any value the client might have tried to inject), subject and message preserved
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Message under minimum length returns 400
testCases.preconditions: Team A is signed in
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with error "message must be between 5 and 5000 characters"; no row inserted
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Invalid scope value rejected
testCases.preconditions: Team A is signed in
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with error "scope must be 'site' or 'league'"; no row inserted
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Unauthenticated POST rejected
testCases.preconditions: No session cookie
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 401 with error "Not authenticated"; no row inserted
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Message at the 5000-character boundary accepted
testCases.preconditions: Team A is signed in
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201; row inserted with the exact message preserved
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: League admin sees only league-scoped feedback for their league
testCases.preconditions: League L1 has 3 league-scoped feedback rows; the DB also has 2 site-scoped rows and 4 rows for league L2; the requester is an admin of active L1 only
testSteps: 1. GET the endpoint with the L1 admin's session.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200; response.feedback.length === 3; every row has scope="league" and leagueId=L1; ordered by createdAt DESC; no site-scope and no L2 rows leak in
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Cross-league admin access blocked
testCases.preconditions: Admin A1 is registered as admin of L1 only; league L2 also exists with feedback rows
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 403
testCases.postconditions: no DB change; no rows leaked
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Superadmin sees only site-scoped feedback
testCases.preconditions: DB has 5 site-scoped rows and 7 league-scoped rows; requester is superadmin
testSteps: 1. GET the endpoint with a superadmin session.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200; response.feedback.length === 5; every row has scope="site"; ordered by createdAt DESC
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: League admin (not superadmin) blocked from site feedback
testCases.preconditions: Admin A1 is a league admin, not a superadmin
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 403
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Toggle important flag
testCases.preconditions: Row F (scope="league" in L1, isImportant=false); requester is admin of L1
testSteps: 2. SELECT * FROM feedback WHERE id = F.id.
3. PATCH a second time with the same body.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 → HTTP 200; row's isImportant=true and updatedAt bumped. Step 3 → HTTP 200; row's isImportant=false again
testCases.postconditions: row's createdAt unchanged; updatedAt updated twice
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Mark resolved with note, then re-open
testCases.preconditions: Row F (resolvedAt=null); requester is league admin
testCases.testData: PATCH { action: "toggle-resolved", resolutionNote: "Fixed in GW9 export." }
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 → HTTP 200; resolvedAt=now(), resolutionNote="Fixed in GW9 export.". Step 3 → HTTP 200; resolvedAt=null, resolutionNote=null
testCases.postconditions: row exists; updatedAt bumped both times
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Cross-league mutation blocked
testCases.preconditions: Row F belongs to league L2; requester is admin of L1 only (not superadmin)
testSteps: 1. PATCH with the L1 admin's session.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 403; row unchanged
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: League admin cannot mutate site-scoped feedback
testCases.preconditions: Row F has scope="site"; requester is a league admin (not superadmin)
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 403; row unchanged
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Superadmin can mutate any feedback row regardless of scope
testCases.preconditions: Row S has scope="site"; row L has scope="league" in L1; requester is superadmin
testCases.expectedResult: Both → HTTP 200; both rows' isImportant flipped to true
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Delete a feedback row

testSteps: 2. SELECT * FROM feedback WHERE id = F.id.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 → HTTP 200. Step 2 → 0 rows.

testCases.testData: DELETE FROM leagues WHERE id = L1.id
testSteps: 1. Count feedback rows before: total = N.
4. Verify the 2 site-scope rows still exist.

testSteps: 1. Open the URL with no session.

testCases.scenario: Resolution note shown inline when row is marked resolved
testCases.preconditions: Row F has resolvedAt set and resolutionNote="Fixed in GW9."; admin is on the Feedback tab

testCases.author: qa-tester
